classification.difficultyReason: No diagram is given. Parts a to c scaffold the inclusion-exclusion idea: the union is 60-9=51, the sum of the two sets is 63, and the excess is 12. Part d needs the interpretive step that the overcount equals the number studying both, then a probability. This is harder than completing a given Venn diagram, as in p16-q16. It is easier than p17-q19, which needs the same overlap deduction with no scaffolding.
